title: Chapter 11 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of accessibility in JavaScript frameworks.

questions.question: Why do SPAs (Single Page Applications) require special attention to accessibility?
options: Content updates happen without full page reloads, so screen reader users may miss changes
questions.explanation: Without a page reload, we must manually manage focus and announce navigation.

questions.question: What should you always update when a route changes in an SPA for accessibility?
questions.explanation: Document title confirms the new page; focus management places users at the start of new content.

questions.question: React automatically handles keyboard events for custom interactive elements.
questions.explanation: You must implement `onKeyDown` handlers for custom elements; only native elements handle keyboard events automatically.

questions.question: Which React hook helps generate unique IDs for label‑input association?
questions.explanation: `useId` (React 18+) creates stable, unique IDs suitable for accessibility.

questions.question: In Vue, why do we use `nextTick()` before focusing an element after a state change?
options: It's a Vue style guide rule
To wait for the DOM to update before setting focus
questions.explanation: `nextTick` ensures the element exists in the DOM before we attempt to focus it.

questions.question: Angular CDK's `cdkTrapFocus` directive is used to confine keyboard focus within a _____.
questions.explanation: Focus trapping is essential for modals to prevent background interaction.

questions.question: What does the Angular CDK `LiveAnnouncer` service do?
options: Creates a hidden live region and speaks messages for screen readers
questions.explanation: `LiveAnnouncer` uses `aria-live` regions to announce dynamic content.

questions.question: A component library claiming to be accessible means you don't need to audit it.
questions.explanation: Always verify with automated and manual testing; claims can be inaccurate or outdated.

questions.question: Which of the following is a known accessible React component library?
questions.explanation: Radix UI builds unstyled, accessible primitives.

questions.question: How should you handle focus after a user deletes a list item in a React app?
options: Move focus to the next logical item or previous one
questions.explanation: Preserving focus context prevents the user from getting lost.

questions.question: In Vue, which attribute binds dynamic ARIA attributes?
questions.explanation: Use `:aria-label="dynamicText"` to bind ARIA attributes.

questions.question: Why is it important to use `tabindex='-1'` on the target of a skip link in an SPA?
options: To make the element focusable without adding it to the tab order
questions.explanation: The container is not natively focusable; `tabindex='-1'` allows programmatic focus.

questions.question: Angular's Reactive Forms automatically associate error messages with inputs.
questions.explanation: You must explicitly use `aria-describedby` to link the error element to the input.

questions.question: Which Angular directive can you use to trap focus in a modal?
questions.explanation: `cdkTrapFocus` is part of Angular CDK's a11y module.

questions.question: What is the best way to test a component library's accessibility before adopting it?
options: Run axe DevTools on its demo pages and test with a screen reader
questions.explanation: Real testing reveals actual compliance, not just claims.

questions.question: In React, why might you use `forwardRef` on a component?
options: To allow a parent to access the underlying DOM node for focus management
questions.explanation: Ref forwarding enables parent components to call `.focus()` on a child's DOM element.

questions.question: You should always use `role='application'` in single‑page apps because they are applications.
questions.explanation: `role='application'` disables screen reader navigation commands; it should be used sparingly, if at all.

questions.question: What does the `@after‑enter` event in Vue's `<Transition>` allow you to do?
options: Execute code after the enter transition completes, which is ideal for setting focus
questions.explanation: Focusing during the transition may fail; waiting until after ensures the element is visible.

questions.question: What is the primary role of a 'route announcer'?
options: To log routes to the console
To speak navigation changes to screen reader users via a live region
To highlight the current route in the nav
questions.explanation: A route announcer uses `aria-live` to confirm page navigation for non‑visual users.

questions.question: Which library provides a `useFocusable` hook for building custom accessible components in React?
questions.explanation: React‑ARIA provides hooks that manage keyboard, focus, and ARIA for custom widgets.

questions.question: Vue's `v‑model` on a custom component automatically makes it fully accessible.
questions.explanation: `v‑model` handles data binding, but you still need to implement accessible name, role, and keyboard.

questions.question: When wrapping a third‑party component to improve its accessibility, what should you avoid?
options: Duplicating or conflicting ARIA attributes that the component already provides
questions.explanation: Duplicate or conflicting ARIA can break the component's accessibility; inspect the original first.
